We applied template 29646 to target molecule. It returned three possible precursor sets (tuples). Need to parse result: It seems each tuple contains a single SMILES string? Actually result is a tuple of tuples each containing a string. So three possible precursors (single product each). For retrosynthesis we need route with 5 reactions using templates in order: ['29646','1914389','1914390','149040','1914391'].

Thus we need to apply sequentially: first template 29646 to target gives precursors. Choose one that can be further processed by next template 1914389, etc.

We need to check each precursor with next template. Use check_smiles_reaction_template_matching to see if template applies. Let's pick first precursor: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C". That's a silyl protected alcohol maybe. Next template 1914389 likely does something like deprotection? Not sure. Let's test matching.
